strike_01.visual_flavor: A clean generic strike: blade edge, baton hit, or muzzle impact with no class bias. The most neutral attack art in the set.

defend_01.visual_flavor: A simple compact shield module or forearm plate. Starter cards should be plain and universal.

surge_strike_01.visual_flavor: A harder-hitting charged strike wrapped in blue electrical force. Shared offense, larger and brighter than Strike.

firewall_01.visual_flavor: A reinforced thermal shield wall or burning security barrier. One barricade silhouette with contained flame.

patch_kit_01.visual_flavor: A med-and-repair kit with cleanser spray, bandage tape, and neutral serum ampoules. Utility item shot, not a character scene.

cache_draw_01.visual_flavor: A generic data cache chip stack or magazine of blank cards. Utility icon with readable shape.

overclock_01.visual_flavor: A compact booster chip or battery tap flaring blue-white. Shared tech power-up; no class bias.

volley_01.visual_flavor: A quick burst of multiple rounds or repeated muzzle flashes. Three short beats, neutral tech palette.

status_burn_01.visual_flavor: A burning warning chit or ember-eaten scrap ticket with a small orange glow. Keep status cards simpler and more symbolic than normal cards.

status_glitch_01.visual_flavor: A broken display mask or error face with scrambled pixels and torn scanlines. Status card art should feel like a hazard ticket, not a full scene.

status_lag_01.visual_flavor: A buffering ring or progress bar frozen mid-load with drag arrows. Abstract UI hazard imagery is fine here.

status_junk_01.visual_flavor: A pile of bolts, broken chips, bent plates, and useless machine trash. Simple pile silhouette, easy to read.

enforcer_bash_protocol_01.visual_flavor: An armored baton or steel fist impact with fresh red slash trails and a brutal bleed marker. Heavy contact frame; no fancy environment.

enforcer_double_tap_01.visual_flavor: Two quick muzzle flares or mirrored baton strikes hitting in immediate succession. Keep the composition symmetric and punchy.

enforcer_breaker_line_01.visual_flavor: A breach maul or breaker hammer splitting armor in a single harsh line. This should feel like armor-breaking force.

enforcer_blood_rush_01.visual_flavor: A reckless forward lunge driven by a self-cut palm and a brutal cleaver or stock strike. Show commitment and momentum, not finesse.

enforcer_crackdown_01.visual_flavor: A stun baton and lock-on reticle pinning the target into a vulnerable opening. The vulnerability setup is more important than raw impact.

enforcer_riot_barrage_01.visual_flavor: A triple-hit barrage of shotgun blasts, shells, or baton flashes in a hard rhythm. Use three beats of motion, not a busy firefight.

enforcer_guard_stance_01.visual_flavor: A riot shield braced low with sparks skipping off its edge. Pure defensive silhouette, simple and iconic.

enforcer_battle_roar_01.visual_flavor: A masked enforcer barking through a vox grille, projecting a crimson shockwave. The voice burst should be the main shape.

enforcer_hard_commit_01.visual_flavor: A danger-marked overdrive switch rammed fully forward. This is a decision image: one switch, one surge, no scene clutter.

enforcer_ram_guard_01.visual_flavor: A shield-first shoulder rush keeping a defensive plate between user and target. Blend protection and impact in one silhouette.

enforcer_open_wound_01.visual_flavor: A deliberate palm slash or wound-port being opened to feed strength. Controlled self-harm, not gore.

enforcer_feed_aggression_01.visual_flavor: A red stimulant injector or adrenal canister slammed into an armored gauntlet. The buff source should read instantly.

enforcer_war_engine_01.visual_flavor: A compact war engine or piston heart building pressure every turn. Mechanical strength-gain icon rather than a full mech.

enforcer_chain_assault_01.visual_flavor: A chain-fed attack rig, shell feeder, or strike counter spooling up the next hit. Use machinery and repetition instead of a character pose.

enforcer_redline_core_01.visual_flavor: A glowing reactor heart with hazard needles, red gauges, and overheating vents. One clear core object; it should feel dangerous to run.

operator_needle_ping_01.visual_flavor: A precision flechette or needle round tagged with a weakening signal blip. Small shot, smart debuff, teal ping line.

operator_quiet_cut_01.visual_flavor: A matte-black vibro knife slicing cleanly with minimal flare. Short, silent, and efficient.

operator_backdoor_01.visual_flavor: A data knife or exploit spike plugged into a secure port. The hack-insertion moment should be the image.

operator_packet_storm_01.visual_flavor: A swarm of data packets or micro-drones flooding a target lane. The storm should feel controlled, not messy.

operator_relay_shot_01.visual_flavor: A shot bouncing through relay nodes or a signal repeater sightline. Use one projectile path with relay beacons.

operator_recompile_shot_01.visual_flavor: A charged rifle shot breaking into teal code fragments as the next move gets cheaper. One rifle or beam plus code breakup is enough.

operator_cache_cycle_01.visual_flavor: A rotating holo-cache carousel or stack of smart cartridges cycling forward. This should read as elegant card flow.

operator_deflect_mesh_01.visual_flavor: A clean hex-mesh barrier unfolding from a wrist projector. Emphasize the mesh pattern and neat geometry.

operator_priority_queue_01.visual_flavor: Stacked priority bars, arrow tracks, and a queue chip bubbling to the top. Simple UI-object composition is ideal.

operator_reroute_01.visual_flavor: A cable junction panel bending current into a new path. Readable block or arrow silhouette over flashy effects.

operator_cold_read_01.visual_flavor: A wafer-thin dossier or holographic case file opening into a pale blue scan. Keep it cool, analytical, and slightly detached.

operator_lock_in_01.visual_flavor: A targeting clamp or software lock icon freezing a decision in place. Stable composition; nothing chaotic.

operator_auto_tuner_01.visual_flavor: A sleek tuning module with dial, waveform, and cost bars dropping into perfect alignment. Calm precision, teal UI glow, one device.

operator_deep_cache_01.visual_flavor: A hidden vault drawer or encrypted memory block opening one layer deeper. Less action, more hidden value.

operator_control_tower_01.visual_flavor: A compact antenna tower or drone uplink with concentric signal rings. The tower silhouette should dominate.

bio_leech_jab_01.visual_flavor: A narrow syringe gauntlet punching in and siphoning glowing fluid back through clear tubing. One strong jab shape plus return-flow hose is enough.

bio_hemorrhage_01.visual_flavor: A self-piercing injector blade or puncture gun drawing neon blood to fuel a violent forward strike. The self-damage cost should read through a small blood pull, not a gore splash.

bio_parasite_fang_01.visual_flavor: A heavier parasite harpoon or injector-fang with hooked mandibles and pumping serum canisters. This should read as a premium infect finisher.

bio_pain_probe_01.visual_flavor: A slim biopsy spike or shock-lancet thrusting forward with a sharp green flash. Fast, compact, and needle-like.

bio_rot_slash_01.visual_flavor: A corroded scalpel or mono-blade leaving a toxic ember slash and a burning residue ticket behind it. The burn-status tie-in should be visible as residue, ash, or a cursed scrap.

bio_harvest_bite_01.visual_flavor: A biomech jaw or injector-fang assembly snapping shut twice, spitting infected green droplets. Lean into predatory biotech rather than a normal knife attack.

bio_scar_tissue_01.visual_flavor: Layered scar tissue and synthetic mesh knitting into a hard defensive patch. Favor close-up body-tech texture over a scene.

bio_triage_loop_01.visual_flavor: A compact auto-doc halo cycling syringes around a medical ring and heart monitor pulse. This should feel like clinical speed and efficiency.

bio_spare_organs_01.visual_flavor: A field cooler of cloned organs and preserved tissue packs ready for emergency use. Keep the silhouette tidy and game-readable.

bio_coagulate_01.visual_flavor: A clotting spray or gel cartridge hardening into a dark biogel plate over an arm or rib panel. Show flesh-and-tech sealing together instead of a full character scene.

bio_reclaimer_01.visual_flavor: A cracked stim canister or recycler pump feeding reclaimed charge into a gauntlet. Show loss-for-power conversion rather than a heal effect.

bio_blood_buffer_01.visual_flavor: A suspended blood-buffer canister swelling into a protective bio-shield, with green-lit tubing and a semi-translucent crimson fluid core. Keep it as one centered medical object with a readable shield silhouette.

bio_symbiote_mesh_01.visual_flavor: A living symbiote mesh wrapping an arm or torso and pulsing with mutual healing light. Make the mesh feel alive but not monstrous.

bio_pain_circuit_01.visual_flavor: A rib-mounted pain-feedback circuit board with exposed leads, one junk cartridge, and a harsh green pulse. Make it feel like a permanent body mod, not a handheld item.

bio_rot_harvest_01.visual_flavor: A grimy rot harvester crucible converting burned status scraps into green energy and a heartbeat pulse. Use a small furnace or grinder silhouette with status trash being consumed.

enforcer_gouge_01.visual_flavor: A hooked blade tearing across armor with a mean red bleed trail. Sharper and nastier than Bash Protocol.

enforcer_spiked_harness_01.visual_flavor: A brutal chest harness of spikes and reactive plates that flash when struck. Show defensive retaliation through spikes and short red sparks.

operator_static_haze_01.visual_flavor: A fog of screen snow and teal static arcs clouding the target's output. The weak effect should feel electronic, not mystical.

operator_zero_day_burst_01.visual_flavor: A burst of exploit shards or digital bugs striking three times in sequence. Three crisp beats of impact and teal fragments.

bio_septic_round_01.visual_flavor: A toxic syringe round or septic casing rupturing with thick green droplets. Read as ammunition with infection, not generic poison.

bio_waste_recycler_01.visual_flavor: A stained recycler grinder chewing junk into charge and card flow. One junk chute, one spinning chamber, one output glow.

drift_error_knife_01.visual_flavor: A zero-cost corrupted knife made from red error text, its edge broken into sharp UI fragments.

drift_unsafe_overclock_01.visual_flavor: A cracked booster chip venting warning light, too bright and too hot for a safe install.

drift_null_refund_01.visual_flavor: A black refund chit with a null glyph punched through it, folding value back into a dead account.

drift_mirror_cache_01.visual_flavor: A mirrored cache drawer reflecting duplicate card silhouettes through blue-black glass.

drift_black_ice_bloom_01.visual_flavor: A black-ice flower blooming from a frozen data shard, petals edged with hostile code.

audit_hound.visual_flavor: A lean compliance hound of matte navy armor, white scanner eyes, and tracked-jaw plating built like a police dog crossed with an audit drone.

compliance_engine_ax9.visual_flavor: A hulking corridor-pacification engine with slab shields, riot shutters, cyan warning bars, and a siege-cannon chest.

director_vale.visual_flavor: A severe executive commander in tailored black tactical wear, a white data visor, and control drones orbiting like bodyguards.

null_baton_officer.visual_flavor: A cold security officer with a collapsible null baton, crisp visor stripe, and a compact suppression harness.

patrol_drone.visual_flavor: A hovering patrol drone with a camera eye, a cyan tracking cone, and a clipped utility chassis built for checkpoint work.

riot_guard.visual_flavor: A broad armored guard behind a rectangular riot shield with heavy boots, cyan compliance lights, and a blunt baton silhouette.

sentry_node.visual_flavor: A squat deployable turret-node with folding legs, a dish eye, and fortified shutter plating around a compact gun core.

signal_analyst.visual_flavor: A thin control specialist framed by floating reticles, signal bars, and mark-projection screens instead of brute armor.

suppression_sniper.visual_flavor: A long-barreled suppression marksman with a rigid firing frame, pale targeting beam, and a severe anti-personnel silhouette.

turret_handler.visual_flavor: A support tech dragging a portable turret cradle, cable spools, and folding mount hardware through a lockstep corridor.

ashfang_rook.visual_flavor: A scarred war-chief in layered road leathers, ember cape strips, and a hooked command weapon raised over a roaring pack.

burner.visual_flavor: A scavenger bomber with a fuel-canister backpack, torch nozzle, and a soot-black mask lit by furnace orange.

burner_mite.visual_flavor: A tiny volatile scrap-creature glowing from within with ember seams, hot vents, and a skittering bomb-like silhouette.

chain_brute.visual_flavor: A massive bruiser swinging chain-wrapped metal with a slab frame, weld scars, and momentum-driven posture.

dust_knife.visual_flavor: A fast desert cutthroat with paired blades, wrapped face cloth, and a low forward-leaning silhouette built for quick blood.

furnace_hound.visual_flavor: A tracked scrap war-beast with a furnace maw, smokestack spine, and glowing heat vents like an industrial predator.

road_hyena.visual_flavor: A rangy scrapland beast with plated ribs, oil-stained fur, and a pack-hunter grin stretched over mean teeth.

scavver.visual_flavor: A thin scavenger ganger in patched scrap armor, quick limbs, and looted gear hanging from every strap.

scrap_caller.visual_flavor: A raider summoner beating a scrap totem or horn rig, with dangling chains and pack-signaling smoke around them.

scrap_gunner.visual_flavor: A swaggering gunner braced behind a brutal homemade firearm, ammo belts, and dust-blown goggles.

junction_9_sentinel.visual_flavor: An old civic-defense automaton of white-gray armor plates, signal pylons, and sealed municipal authority geometry.

spine_warden_null.visual_flavor: A severe adaptive guardian in pale machine armor with blank null-glyph panels and a saintlike control halo.

toll_reeve.visual_flavor: A route-lord in tollkeeper regalia with an armored cloak, tax sigils, and a weaponized checkpoint silhouette.

culture_shepherd.visual_flavor: A biotech handler with culture tanks, hanging specimen bags, and hooked tools guiding living fodder.

failed_saint.visual_flavor: A warped devotional experiment draped in ragged medical vestments, grafted limbs, and wet pale biolight.

gland_brute.visual_flavor: A swollen muscle horror with serum sacs, graft lines, and a frontal battering-ram silhouette.

leech_nurse.visual_flavor: A clinical siphon-attendant with drain lines, bone-white apron panels, and predatory bedside calm.

miremother_vexa.visual_flavor: A regal Helix overseer grown into a mire-throne of vats, tendrils, and living biomass attendants.

scalpel_runner.visual_flavor: A thin rushdown surgeon with blade limbs, specimen belts, and a fast incision-first posture.

serum_acolyte.visual_flavor: A devoted lab adept carrying serum injectors, clean masks, and glowing recovery fluids like sacred implements.

sludge_whelp.visual_flavor: A low, wet toxic whelp of stitched flesh and chemical slime with a snapping maw and sickly green seepage.

graft_saint.visual_flavor: A towering martyr-horror stitched from sacred biotech, bone-white plating, and self-regenerating organ bloom.

enemy_elite_01.visual_flavor: A generic corp enforcer in plain tactical armor with a baton-or-sidearm stance, intentionally placeholder-grade beside the authored Blackwire roster.

enemy_boss_01.visual_flavor: A broad generic boss figure in heavy urban armor and a command coat, built as a placeholder apex human silhouette.

enemy_basic_01.visual_flavor: A generic street thug in cheap leathers and a pipe-weapon stance, intentionally simple as placeholder enemy art.

caravan_reaver.visual_flavor: A brutal caravan raider in dust cloaks and scavenged plates, carrying a heavy hooked weapon for close kills.

carrion_hound.visual_flavor: A desert scavenger hound with bone ornaments, a torn harness, and blood-tracking jaws.

dune_raider.visual_flavor: A lean dune fighter in sun-bleached wraps and scavenged gear, sprinting with knife-forward aggression.

dust_saboteur.visual_flavor: A wiry saboteur with satchels, clog bombs, and dust-stained patchwork equipment.

embersnout.visual_flavor: A pig-snouted explosive brute with furnace nostrils, cinder hide, and a hot-breath silhouette built for short violent bursts.

relay_vulture.visual_flavor: A scavenger vulture hybrid with antenna wings, mark optics, and a high perched firing pose.

salvage_bulwark.visual_flavor: A blocky frontline scavenger wrapped in welded scrap plates and a door-sized salvage shield.

sandpack_alpha.visual_flavor: A dominant pack alpha crowned with bone trophies, scarred hide, and a dust-storm command presence.

scrap_ticker.visual_flavor: A small ticking machine scavenger with exposed gears, signal lights, and nuisance-bot personality.

signal_junker.visual_flavor: A wasteland controller wrapped in scavenged signal gear, null-tech charms, and a ragged tracker silhouette.

waste_leech.visual_flavor: A parasitic desert leech slick with infected fluid and a hooked feeding mouth built for ugly close contact.

wastes_colossus.visual_flavor: A giant red-wastes war construct of bone-lashed scrap, crushing bulk, and rust-burn exhaust stacks.

adrenal_surge.visual_flavor: A snap-in combat stim ampoule and injector pen glowing with reckless orange charge and first-turn heat.

arterial_reservoir.visual_flavor: A hanging arterial tank of dark red fluid with pressure dials and a bleed overflow pipe.

ash_veil.visual_flavor: A soot-black veil catching ember sparks along its hem as it dulls incoming burn.

auction_seeder.visual_flavor: A gilded auction seedbox with bid tabs, sale lights, and branching price markers ready to bloom into more options.

authority_bypass.visual_flavor: A tri-channel bypass module with three keyed faces and an illicit jumper wire bridging all of them at once.

black_ice_scar.visual_flavor: A shard-black implant sliver with frosted blue edges and a permanent wound-line running through it.

blood_indexer.visual_flavor: A blood-stained index wheel with tally teeth and red markers advancing toward overflow.

blood_money.visual_flavor: A blood-smeared payout chit or brass coin purse with red ledger marks and a predatory shine.

blood_pact.visual_flavor: A ritual contract blade or oath tag tied with red cord and a still-wet thumbprint.

bone_receipt.visual_flavor: A rigid receipt spike threaded with bone-white tabs and pain turned into a formal tally.

butcher_hooks.visual_flavor: A pair of industrial butcher hooks on a cable hub, stained steel with one sharp red accent. Keep the silhouette simple enough to read as a small cutout icon.

carbon_weave.visual_flavor: A beveled square of carbon-fiber weave with stitched or riveted corners. Preserve the simple plate silhouette from the current sheet.

champion_contract.visual_flavor: A victor's contract slate signed in gold and pinned with a medal ribbon and a clean white seal.

cinder_feedback.visual_flavor: A heat-damaged feedback coil wrapped in ash cloth, ready to spit stored fire back at the room.

clean_slate.visual_flavor: A handheld tablet with a clean blue screen and a physical eraser block clipped to one edge. Readable and simple; almost stationery-tech.

containment_loop.visual_flavor: A sealed containment collar ring with clear vials and a calm green lock light holding infection at bay.

controlled_bleed_valve.visual_flavor: A surgical pressure valve with a crimson drip gauge and a return-feed tube for repeated cuts.

debt_mark.visual_flavor: A stamped debtor brand plate with descending credit ticks and collection sigils.

debt_spike.visual_flavor: A predatory finance spike or contract stylus with barbed edges and courier branding.

deep_pockets.visual_flavor: A hardened chip wallet overstuffed with stacked credit slugs and zipper rings pulling at the seams.

echo.visual_flavor: A mirrored waveform token with duplicate edges and a pale afterimage trailing behind it.

efficient.visual_flavor: A clean zero-cost command chip with trimmed edges, teal timing marks, and perfect economy.

execution_array.visual_flavor: A compact execution module with a sensor eye and three deployable blades or rails. Rare relic; make it elegant and dangerous.

execution_relay.visual_flavor: A lean kill-switch router with an optic eye and a clean relay path from status marker to finishing strike.

exposure_grid.visual_flavor: A projector puck casting a weak-point lattice over armor seams and opened targets.

field_dampener.visual_flavor: A palm-sized dampening puck or collar coil with concentric rings that absorb hostile status energy. Show containment, not offense.

flash_cache.visual_flavor: A compact datastick with a bright cyan cache core. Simple 3/4 angle, cutout-friendly.

flesh_dividend.visual_flavor: A biotech dividend engine of pumps, blood meters, and profit needles turning self-harm into a payout.

fractured_armor.visual_flavor: A cracked armor plate held together by failing welds and stress braces.

fresh_kill_chain.visual_flavor: A trophy chain loaded with kill tokens and sharpened clasps, built to spin one death into the next advantage.

ghost_budget.visual_flavor: A translucent ledger chip with discount arrows, ghosted numerals, and a clean white spending lock.

ghost_warranty.visual_flavor: A translucent warranty chip flickering with ghosted receipt text and shop-terminal glow.

glitch_state.visual_flavor: A corrupted status badge of jittering pixels, split colors, and unstable signal tears.

glass_engine.visual_flavor: A fragile engine capsule of glass chambers and exposed pressure lines glowing with unstable power.

grave_lantern.visual_flavor: A black lantern venting red bleed haze and pale green weakening fumes. Use one lantern silhouette and subtle dual-color vapor.

grave_matrix.visual_flavor: A black status lattice or grave-matrix frame humming with paired weakness and exposed-seam glyphs.

grave_pick.visual_flavor: A compact grave pick or powered miner's pick with a small energy cell in the shaft. Uncommon relic; simple but slightly mean.

grave_sprinkler.visual_flavor: A funerary sprinkler head spraying red mist and pale weakening vapor in a cold circular pattern.

grave_static.visual_flavor: A tomb-radio handset crackling with dead signal and status noise over a dark speaker grille.

grave_toll.visual_flavor: A small iron toll bell on a chain, worn smooth by deaths counted one at a time.

high_roller.visual_flavor: A sharp-edged casino marker plated in gold and hazard red, flashy enough to promise winnings and trouble.

jam_battery.visual_flavor: A thick battery block with spent status strips jammed into charging teeth along its spine.

jam_cycler.visual_flavor: A grinder gearbox or cassette shredder with jammed status strips caught in its teeth. It should feel like it chews through status cards.

lag_harvest.visual_flavor: A slow-turn capacitor or hourglass battery fed by the drag and friction of status junk.

lean_market.visual_flavor: A bargain-market receipt roll wrapped around a cracked price gun and a starving little lockbox.

market_ghost.visual_flavor: A phantom price tag or shop-spirit keyfob hovering with pale green markdown light.

market_key.visual_flavor: A brass-steel key with a green chip insert and secure cut teeth. Keep the shape elegant and iconic.

marker_scrambler.visual_flavor: A jammer disc fuzzing target reticles with static rings and scrambled white brackets.

momentum.visual_flavor: A forward-tilted speed emblem of rev bars and attack chevrons, always leaning into the next hit.

mortuary_router.visual_flavor: An embalmer router box with a red kill-light, card slots, and precise channels for weaponized cleanup.

mummified_wire.visual_flavor: A wrapped cable bundle with dried insulator strips, preserved nodes, and occult-looking power discipline.

null_damper.visual_flavor: A blanking muffler coil or nullifier puck with a muted signal emblem. Control relic; feel suppressive and defensive.

open_circuit_brand.visual_flavor: A heated branding iron with a broken-circuit sigil and a live orange seam down the center.

overclock_relay.visual_flavor: A heavy relay cube with a cooling fan, cables, and a small orange status LED. Preserve the squat box silhouette from the current sheet.

overheat.visual_flavor: A hazard-red heat regulator with warning needles buried in the danger zone.

parasite_seal.visual_flavor: A quarantine seal stamped over a specimen vial and leech silhouette, forcing the infection back under glass.

patch_priority.visual_flavor: A clinic priority band or service token with green cross lights and fast-track chevrons.

plated_grip.visual_flavor: A plated armored glove with chunky defensive knuckles. One glove, no hand attached.

pressure_mesh.visual_flavor: A tension-reading mesh plate threaded with weak-point lines and defensive sensor nodes.

pressure_sight.visual_flavor: A cyber monocle or tactical lens projecting a weak-point reticle. Let the lens shape dominate; only small UI accents.

protocol_drift.visual_flavor: A corrupted protocol cassette wrapped in glitch haze and crossed-out control glyphs.

quarantine_vault.visual_flavor: A locked anti-status vault canister with a green negative-pressure window and isolation clamps.

queue_mirror.visual_flavor: A polished queue token reflecting a zero-cost icon back at itself in perfect symmetry.

reaper_census.visual_flavor: A census tablet etched with skull tallies, official seals, and one cold column reserved for the next dead enemy.

recycler_crown.visual_flavor: A jagged crown made of shredder teeth, ticket scraps, and improvised feed rollers.

riot_gyro.visual_flavor: A stabilizer gyro built from riot hardware, spinning heavier each time attack cadence builds.

riot_plating.visual_flavor: A riot plate pauldron with bold power chevrons and heavy red surface wear.

rot_battery.visual_flavor: A corroded battery canister or cell with verdant seepage and stitched casing seams. This should feel bio-hacker adjacent but still relic-simple.

salvage_license.visual_flavor: A stamped salvage permit card clipped to a chain, with brass corners and payout marks scratched into the surface.

scrap_choir.visual_flavor: A choir of tiny scrap bells and speaker tubes singing through junk with a surprisingly warm tone.

momentum.visual_flavor: Forward-slashing speed lines, revved engine glow, and a wound-up attack posture.

overheat.visual_flavor: Orange pressure gauges, furnace coils, and heat haze bleeding from metal seams.

biomass.visual_flavor: Wet organic matter pooling in vats and feeding thick green growth into a central mass.

mutated.visual_flavor: A sudden body shift of split skin, exposed grafts, and phase-change growth bursting through.

bio_hacker.visual_flavor: A lean biotech scavenger-doctor wrapped in green surgical glow, tubing, and reclaimed flesh-tech implants.

enforcer.visual_flavor: A blunt-force bruiser in crimson riot armor, battered plates, and industrial weapons with almost no wasted motion.

operator.visual_flavor: A calm precision hacker in teal-lit tactical wear, clean devices, and screen glow replacing ornament.

backalley_casino_01.visual_flavor: A cramped neon gambling den with folding tables, hidden cameras, and a pit boss smiling behind cheap velvet and dirty light.

black_ice_cache_01.visual_flavor: A locked shard vault glowing cold blue in a dark alley, with frostlike data spikes crawling over its casing.

black_ice_scar_01.visual_flavor: A black-ice shard hovering like a cursed sliver of glass, leaving a luminous wound-pattern in the air.

crash_chassis_01.visual_flavor: A stripped combat frame sprawled in a wreck bay, half-disassembled and still dangerous with live warning lights.

credit_shakedown_01.visual_flavor: A narrow alley choke point with two enforcers, neon rain, and a demanded payment hanging in the air.

dead_drop_01.visual_flavor: A tram-bench dead drop with a blinking courier cache tucked into urban grime and electric shadow.

debt_spike_01.visual_flavor: A slick broker booth with premium courier branding, hidden fine print, and a needlelike contract device.

ghost_warranty_01.visual_flavor: A half-real market phantom leaning over a kiosk, offering a glowing warranty chip from behind static.

glitch_lottery_01.visual_flavor: A hacked public terminal pulsing with corrupt icons, missing text blocks, and tempting jackpot screens.

glitch_shrine_01.visual_flavor: A shrine of stacked scavenged monitors, candles of static, and looping error prayers flickering between grace and failure.

memory_scrubber_01.visual_flavor: A gray-market scrub station of old recliner, surgical light, and data-erasing tools laid out like contraband dentistry.

relay_tuner_01.visual_flavor: A quiet tuning bench filled with signal meters, cable reels, and one delicately calibrated relay core.

stim_lab_01.visual_flavor: A cracked med-station with open stimulant ports, hanging IV bags, and warning strips over broken clinical glass.

street_choir_01.visual_flavor: A broken plaza full of humming speakers and signal towers, where unseen voices ripple through dust and neon.

street_clinic_01.visual_flavor: A rough street clinic under a neon tarp with patched instruments, stained steel, and improvised mercy.

unstable_chip_01.visual_flavor: An illicit combat chip resting in shock foam, glowing too hot and unstable for any legal hardware bay.

signal_busker_01.visual_flavor: A lone busker under a rain-warped awning, face hidden behind a speaker mask, with signal notes bending neon puddles around them.

rainwater_condenser_01.visual_flavor: A jury-rigged rooftop water tank with copper fins, rain strings, and a clean blue drip glowing against dirty city haze.

spare_battery_shrine_01.visual_flavor: A sidewalk altar stacked with disposable cells, prayer tags, warning stickers, and a single pulsing battery core.

broken_firewall_kiosk_01.visual_flavor: A cracked public-security kiosk coughing blue firewall tickets from a jammed printer mouth.

butcher_ledger_01.visual_flavor: A hanging butcher terminal beside steel hooks, with red ledger lines crawling across a greasy glass display.

market_price_oracle_01.visual_flavor: A tiny fortune kiosk with price tags orbiting a green CRT face and coins jammed into its prediction slot.

scavenger_lunch_01.visual_flavor: A dented cooler under a tarp, with foil meal packets, cracked ice, and a scavenger watching your hands.

street_charger_01.visual_flavor: A sidewalk charging stand with three glowing cables, one clean, one sparking, and one sealed behind warning tape.

overpass_sleepers_01.visual_flavor: A huddled camp beneath concrete, med-blanket glow lighting tired faces and hidden blades.

split_wire_courier_01.visual_flavor: A breathless courier holding twin wire-wrapped parcels, each blinking with a different route color.

ash_seller_01.visual_flavor: A masked ash vendor beside a smoking barrel, with black powder scooped into bright heatproof envelopes.

cheap_implant_rack_01.visual_flavor: A folding vendor rack of cheap implant chips, each sealed in cracked plastic with handwritten warning labels.
